harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt) as DHCP server on the private network (eth1, 192.168.50.0/24) shared with node2/node3. node2 gets a static DHCP reservation (192.168.50.50) keyed to its eth1 MAC, so it always receives the same address across repeated leases; node3 is served from the general pool (192.168.50.100-150) and got 192.168.50.103. Verified with release/renew cycles before and after restarting all three nodes one at a time (boot-identity confirmed changed for each), and confirmed the config, service, and addressing all survived and recovered.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OpenWrt network/firewall/dhcp UCI config and node2/node3 interfaces to find eth1 as the shared private network
Brought up node1 eth1 and created a static 'priv' interface (192.168.50.1/24) via UCI, reloaded network
Added 'priv' network to the lan firewall zone so DHCP service is permitted, reloaded firewall
Configured dnsmasq DHCP server (dhcp.priv) with pool 192.168.50.100-150 and a static host reservation for node2's eth1 MAC at 192.168.50.50
Verified via dhclient on node2/node3 that node2 gets 192.168.50.50 and node3 gets a pool address (192.168.50.103)
Verified node2's address persists across release/renew (repeated lease)
Captured boot_id baseline on all three nodes
Restarted node1, node2, node3 sequentially, polling for exec availability and confirming boot_id changed for each
Post-reboot: verified node1's UCI config and dnsmasq service intact, and both node2 and node3 re-acquired their expected DHCP addresses (192.168.50.50 and 192.168.50.103 respectively)

evidence.requirement: node1 hands out addresses on the private network
evidence.summary: node1 eth1 configured as 192.168.50.1/24 with dnsmasq DHCP server; node2 and node3 successfully obtained leases from it

evidence.requirement: node2 always receives the same address across repeated leases
evidence.summary: Static DHCP host reservation added for node2's MAC (02:9b:00:10:4b:23) -> 192.168.50.50; confirmed same address returned after explicit release/renew and reflected in node1's lease file

evidence.requirement: node3 is addressed from the general pool
evidence.summary: node3 (no reservation) received 192.168.50.103 from the configured pool range 100-150, recorded in node1's lease file

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 73eb5fdf... baseline and dhcp config; issued background reboot; connection timed out during restart; new boot_id dae84f7e...; confirmed dnsmasq running and UCI config intact; node2 re-verified reservation still works

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id b35fad86... baseline; issued reboot; connection timed out; new boot_id 1f80f9c0...; post-reboot dhclient renewal confirmed node2 still gets reserved 192.168.50.50

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 3dba43a5... baseline; issued reboot; connection timed out then refused; new boot_id d2aaaaea...; post-reboot dhclient confirmed node3 still gets pool address 192.168.50.103
